title: astramem-retrieval@1 query envelope
description: Query envelope for the shared retrieval contract (ADR-005). Both engines accept this envelope; they may differ internally in how they satisfy it.

text.description: Free-form query text. May be empty for filter-only browsing.

scope.description: ADR-009 memory scope. private|team|org only. atom@2 cut (2026-07-09): the 'personal' alias tracked as TODO(remove-personal-alias) (astramem-local#115) is dropped from this filter enum in the same breaking window.

project.description: FEAT-424 canonical project filter: exact match. A single string is `= ?`; a string[] is `IN (...)` (OR-semantics). An empty array is 'no constraint', never match-nothing.

agent.description: FEAT-424 canonical agent filter: exact match on provenance agent/agent_type. A single string is `= ?`; a string[] is `IN (...)` (OR-semantics). AND-composes with `project` when both are present.

entity.description: FEAT-424/FEAT-402: entity name filter, resolved via the engine's normalize seam (case/whitespace-insensitive, exact match then substring fallback). An unresolvable name yields zero results.

as_of.description: Bitemporal time-travel: return the atom state as it was valid at this instant (ADR-001/ADR-005).

explain.description: Explanations are not optional per ADR-005 result contract, but the caller can still choose whether to request the extra payload weight.
